menu_reconciliation.method: Parse literal native tree indentation; omit anonymous menu containers; separate disabled markers; trim label-edge whitespace; exclude eight private Recent locator leaves; exact-match full label tuples without aliases.
menu_reconciliation.matching_ids: All593 original menu IDs except the four explicit not_reobserved_here IDs.

marker_delta.qualification: Context-specific native application/window-lifecycle marker only. Earlier absence of a disabled marker did not independently prove enabled state. No invocation or regression inference.

menu_reconciliation.context_qualification: Edit > Context Menu labels came from exposed descendants. No canvas right-click or selected-pattern/seam action was executed; the original selected-seam additions are preserved.

graphics_reobserved.relation_to_catalog: Same four configured values already recorded; no factory-default or editing/range/persistence qualification.

displayed_shortcut_descriptions.qualification: Displayed hints only; no shortcut pressed or investigator tool activation. Selected-tool behavior and effective bindings remain unverified.

preference_navigation.next_capture: Graphic Options with the same four values; no accepted category change observed.

remaining_contracts: Current units and construction/file/simulation defaults were not reached in this run; prior configured-value observations remain historical and unchanged.

Checked language, numeric locale/regional parsing, effective keyboard bindings, full keyboard/high-DPI behavior and other preference-page contents remain unresolved. English UI/exposed language labels do not establish checked language.

PAT-007 owns names/notches/internal features; PAT-006 owns cuts/holes. This run adds no notch-specific selected-point/segment route, defaults, placement, edit, errors, history, persistence or export behavior. No notch absence is inferred.

Exposed pattern/sewing labels do not extend earlier bounded contracts: arbitrary curve/split/offset/cut input, ID/remapping rules, dart/pleat/clone relations, M:N/unequal-length continuous correspondence, mismatch/easing thresholds, tack/topstitch behavior and cancel/history/persistence/physical effects remain open.
Baseline/settings remain provisional, discovery incomplete and controlled complete-contract comparison not run.
Global settings-file equality and normal application network behavior were not measured.

timing_and_cleanup.qualification: App/window cleanup met600s. Metadata sealing missed the requested600s sealing deadline; no GUI/process action followed cleanup. Full case-bound compliance is not claimed.
